LESSON: GOVERNMENT AND BUSINESS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.2: Government and Business

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Government and Business. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Government and Business
2. Practise Government and Business at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Government and Business

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Government and Business
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Government and Business. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Government and Business at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Government and Business at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Government and Business
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Government and Business. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Government and Business using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Government and Business in the examples.
2. Explain Government and Business to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Government and Business.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Government and Business using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Government and Business important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Government and Business
2. Practise Government and Business at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Government and Business

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
